description_en: Stops a specified run by using the ExecutorJobId returned by RunSemanticJob or ListSemanticJobRuns. A successful call indicates only that the stop request has been accepted. Query the final status by calling GetSemanticJobDetail
description_zh: 使用 RunSemanticJob 或 ListSemanticJobRuns 返回的 ExecutorJobId 停止指定运行。调用成功仅表示停止请求已受理，最终状态请通过 GetSemanticJobDetail 查询
name: KillSemanticJob

parameters.help_en: The executor job ID of the run to stop. Use the Data.ExecutorJobId value from the RunSemanticJob response or the ExecutorJobId from a ListSemanticJobRuns record
parameters.help_zh: 待停止运行的执行器任务标识，使用 RunSemanticJob 响应的 Data.ExecutorJobId 或 ListSemanticJobRuns 记录中的 ExecutorJobId
parameters.name: executor_job_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the DataWorks workspace to which the job belongs. Use the ProjectId from the CreateSemanticJob response or a ListSemanticJobs list item
parameters.help_zh: 待停止任务所属的 DataWorks 工作空间 ID，使用 CreateSemanticJob 响应或 ListSemanticJobs 列表项的 ProjectId
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The number of retries when sending the stop request to the executor. This parameter is optional. Specify a non-negative integer. After the call, confirm the final status by calling GetSemanticJobDetail
parameters.help_zh: 向执行器发起停止请求时使用的重试次数。通常可省略；传入时使用非负整数，并在调用后通过 GetSemanticJobDetail 确认最终状态
parameters.name: retry_times
